_comment: TaskTile rns_ai_only extraction-confidence buckets, per doc category. Hand-maintained, iterate over time. NOT factory-generated. See docs/tasktile-integration-plan.md ('Fallback strategy') and docs/tasktile-extracted-vs-awm-schema.md.

buckets.1: TRUST — rns_ai_only reliably returns this; use the manifest value (fall back only if empty or fails validation).
buckets.2: KNOWN-MISSING — rns_ai_only structurally does not return this; skip the manifest wait and go straight to fallback (cross_doc_source first, else LandingAI/targeted extractor).
buckets.3: CHECK-THEN-FALLBACK (default) — read the manifest; if the value is absent or fails validation, fall back to LandingAI. Safe default for any untested category.

notes: field paths use the AWM content_schema names as the canonical field id; the camelCase->snake manifest mapping is handled separately (tasktile_field_map.json pattern).
'bucket' is the category default for fields not listed in field_overrides.
only categories with 'tested_job' have been empirically verified; everything else is the conservative default (bucket 3).
'cross_doc_source' = prefer a sibling doc's field in the SAME job before paying for LandingAI (category_id of the sibling).

2026-09-23b: TaskTile shipped an ai_only extraction fix (retest job a2643fae). It RESOLVED the big structural gaps — DL owner.idNumber, ALTA escrowCompany/titleCompany/settlementAgent/fileNumber, Purchase sellers[]/sellersAgent, MI premium fields — all now extract. It also REGRESSED Flood (538) and CPL (167), which went sparse. ai_only output shape is unstable run-to-run, so treat single results as directional and let shadow mode confirm over time.
